entries.summary: Ville Virtanen et al. — Two decades ago, two-proton emission from a $(21^+)$ isomeric state in $^{94}$Ag was reported. This report has remained the sole example of possible two-proton radioactivity in a nucleus with an odd number of protons on the chart of nuclei. A debate…
